svg.title: WIP limits on board columns — SoftTrack web design mockup (#270)
svg.desc: A column holds as many cards as are put in it, and the cumulative flow chart shows work piling up a week later. An optional limit per status shows in the column’s header, which says in words when the column is full or over; the drop is allowed unless the team makes the limit hard.

svg.text: Done when a team admin can set an optional limit per status, the column header counts against it and says in words and with an icon when it is over, dropping a card into a full
column is allowed and announced unless the team makes the limit hard, the keyboard move announces the same, moves through the API and by automation follow the rule, and
the cumulative flow chart draws the limit.
